item.text: {"explanation":"Maintains the current register values, capacity, and version in opaque state. For each event, it applies the specified precedence: invalid, stale, conflict, capacity, then unchanged or committed. Successful changed batches update all registers atomically and increment the version once; changed keys are sorted by Unicode code point.","program":"function solve(x){var c=x.config,e=x.event,s=x.state,v,n,cap,k,g=e.guards,u=e.updates,bad=false,status,changed=[],nv,sum;function has(o,k){return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(o,k)}function put(o,k,val){Object.defineProperty(o,k,{value:val,writable:true,enumerable:true,configurable:true})}function copy(o){var r={};Object.keys(o).forEach(function(k){put(r,k,o[k])});return r}function cmp(a,b){var i=0,j=0;while(i<a.length&&j<b.length){var x=a.codePointAt(i),y=b.codePointAt(j);if(x!==y)return x-y;i+=x>65535?2:1;j+=y>65535?2:1}return a.length-i-(b.length-j)}if(s===null){v=copy(c.initial);n=0;cap=c.capacity}else{v=s.v;n=s.n;cap=s.cap}for(k in g)if(has(g,k)&&!has(v,k))bad=true;for(k in u)if(has(u,k)&&(!has(g,k)||!has(v,k)||u[k]<0))bad=true;if(bad)status='invalid';else if(e.version!==n)status='stale';else{for(k in g)if(has(g,k)&&v[k]!==g[k]){status='conflict';break}if(!status){nv=copy(v);for(k in u)if(has(u,k))put(nv,k,u[k]);sum=0;for(k in nv)sum+=nv[k];if(sum>cap)status='capacity';else{for(k in nv)if(nv[k]!==v[k])changed.push(k);changed.sort(cmp);if(changed.length){v=nv;n++;status='committed'}else status='unchanged'}}}return{state:{v:v,n:n,cap:cap},output:{status:status,version:n,values:copy(v),changed:status==='committed'?changed:[]}}}"}
